senses.gloss: ख (II) n. 1. An organ of sense; 2. a city; 3. a field; 4. a cypher; 5. a dot, an anusvāra; 6. the sky, यावद्गिरः खे मरुतां चरंति K.S.iii.72, Megh.i.9; 7. heaven; 8. a cavity, an aperture, a hole, M.ix.43; 9. an aperture of the human body (of which there are nine, viz., the mouth, the two ears, the two eyes, the two nostrils and the organs of excretion and generation), खान्यद्भिः समुपस्पृशेत् Yaj.i.20, M.ii.53, 60, v.132; 10. a wound; 11. happiness, pleasure; 12. tale; 13. Brahman (n).
